# policy-text-diff

Section-aware diff of privacy policy and terms versions using Python (>= 3.10). Features include structural matching (ignoring renumbering), word-level diffs, keyword flagging, and CLI support.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): Overview and usage.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Parsing and matching logic.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Test coverage and policies.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat limits and mitigations.
